packages.label: Modules
packages.hint: Core modules are always included. Tick the add-on modules this plan includes.

payment.label: Payment due (days)
payment.helper: Days to pay the invoice, counted from the start of the period it bills. After that the school is read-only until the invoice is marked paid.
payment.helperBlank: Leave blank to keep the current value.
payment.helperOff: The school is never blocked for an unpaid invoice.
payment.errRange: Payment due must be a whole number from 1 to 365 days.
payment.errRequired: Enter the days to pay, or turn off "Block when unpaid".

renew.unpaidNote: The current invoice is not paid yet. Mark it paid first, or renew from today.
renew.ended: This plan has already ended, so both options start today.
renew.estimateNote: Estimate only. The server calculates the final amount.

school.unpaidMessage: Your subscription invoice was due on {date}. The app is read-only until it is paid. Please pay the invoice or contact your administrator.
school.dueSoon: Invoice due on {date}; after that the app becomes read-only.

addons.title: Add-ons
addons.removeMessage: Remove {label}? Its unpaid invoice is voided and the limit drops back.
addons.unitPriceHint: Plan price: {price}. Changing it applies to this purchase only.
addons.unitPriceNone: This plan lists no price for this. Enter one.
addons.quoteNote: Billed for the days left, on a separate add-on invoice. The limit rises at once.
addons.errQuantity: Quantity must be a whole number from 1 to 100000.
addons.errUnitPrice: Unit price must be 0 or more.
addons.pricesNote: To buy extras, contact the platform admin. Extras are billed only for the days left in the current period.
addons.keepOn: Carried over and billed for the full period: {amount}
addons.keepOff: Dropped. Their unused paid value is credited.
addons.unpaidNote: An add-on invoice is not paid yet. Mark it paid first, or renew from today.
addons.changeNote: Changing the package drops the add-ons. Their unused paid value is credited.
addons.packagePricesHint: Price of one extra unit for one plan period. Leave blank if extras are not sold.
addons.packagePriceError: Add-on prices must be 0 or more.
addons.moduleNone: No module left to buy: the plan includes every module, or add-ons already opened them.
addons.packageModulePricesHint: Price per plan period for a module this plan does not include. Leave blank if it is not sold.
addons.packageModulePricesAllIncluded: This plan includes every module, so none is sold as an add-on.
addons.packageModulePriceError: Module add-on prices must be 0 or more.
addons.modulesNote: To open a module, contact the platform admin. It is billed only for the days left in the current period.

storage.title: Storage
storage.warn: Storage is almost full. Delete old files or ask the platform admin for more storage.
storage.full: Storage is full. Uploads are refused until old files are deleted or more storage is added.
storage.packageError: Storage must be 0 GB or more.

launchOffer.title: Launch offer
launchOffer.hint: The first schools to start on this package pay the launch price and keep it on renewals for the lock period. Clear all three fields to remove the offer.
launchOffer.errPrice: Launch price must be 0 or more.
launchOffer.errMaxSchools: Max schools must be a whole number, 1 or more.
launchOffer.errLockDays: Lock days must be a whole number from 1 to 3650.
launchOffer.applyOn: Pays {price} instead of {full}, locked for {days} days. {left} of {max} slots left.
launchOffer.applyOff: Full price. The school does not take a slot.
launchOffer.detail: {price} for the first {max} schools, locked {days} days ({claimed} claimed)
launchOffer.renewNote: Renews at the locked launch price {price} (until {date}).
